title: RingCentral Wins Two Industry Awards for AI-Powered Customer Engagement and Integrated Communications
summary: RingCentral AI Receptionist (AIR) wins ICMI Best New Technology Solution UC Today names RingCentral Best Integrated UC Solution BELMONT, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- RingCentral, Inc . (NYSE: RNG), a global leader in AI-powered customer engagement, today announced two industry awards recognizing its innovation in helping businesses serve customers, empower employees, and capture more opportunities. RingCentral AI Receptionist ™ (AIR) won Best New Technology Solution at the 2026 ICMI Contact Center Expo , while UC Today named RingCentral Best Integrated UC Solution. “Voice is the most natural way customers reach businesses, and they expect the conversation to keep moving, context intact, with a person there when they need one,” said Kira Makagon, President & COO, RingCentral. “Our platform brings AI and human agents together across the full conversation lifecycle, with humans in the loop. Businesses deliver better customer experiences, give employees time back, and capture more opportunities. These awards recognize that impact.” “Strong customer engagement starts with integrated technology,” said Rob Scott, Publisher, UC Today. “RingCentral winning Best Integrated Solution at the UC Today Awards shows what happens when every capability works as one: seamless for teams, connected for customers. Congratulations to everyone at RingCentral.” Growing adoption. Measurable impact. The awards come as adoption of RingCentral’s AI portfolio accelerates. In the third quarter of 2026 , annual recurring revenue (ARR) from customers using at least one native paid AI product now represents approximately 15% of total ARR or over $400 million, doubling year over year. AI Receptionist, or AIR, now has more than 22,000 customers, up nearly 4x year over year. AIR makes sure businesses never miss a call, turning every call into an opportunity by answering questions, capturing leads, booking appointments, and routing callers with context intact. It’s easy to deploy and works with existing phone systems. The UC Today award recognizes the broader strength of RingCentral’s integrated approach: AI that automates interactions, assists employees, and analyzes conversations. Together, these capabilities form a connected flywheel across customer and employee communications, turning insights into action to make every conversation smarter. Helping customers handle more and achieve more At Cartelligent , RingCentral’s AI suite helps employees spend less time on manual work and more time converting leads into customers. “RingCentral’s AI suite has transformed our operations, allowing us to connect with 100% of live leads during business hours and move toward an 85% lead-to-signup target,” said Jessica Carstens, VP of Operations at Cartelligent. “With automated coaching and AI-generated summaries, we’ve replaced manual ‘busy work’ with strategic growth, all while maintaining an elite 9.85/10 customer satisfaction score.” At JTR Insurance Agency , RingCentral AIR cuts call routing from minutes to seconds, freeing employees to serve clients and saving on operational costs. "Before AIR, it took an average of 5 minutes just to route a call. Now, it takes only 24 seconds,” said Todd Stanley, Owner of JTR Insurance Agency. “By letting AIR completely automate the handling of daily calls, our team no longer has to waste valuable hours manually answering and transferring them. That massive boost in efficiency gives us a 91% time savings and slashes our monthly operational costs." To learn more about RingCentral and its Agentic Voice AI portfolio, visit ringcentral.com . About RingCentral RingCentral is a global leader in AI-powered customer engagement, delivering an integrated platform for business phone, SMS, contact center, workforce engagement management, video collaboration, and messaging. Powered by advanced AI capabilities, RingCentral delivers intelligence at every phase of the conversation journey — before, during, and after each human interaction. With RingCentral, businesses can work smarter, respond faster, and connect more meaningfully with their customers. Visit ringcentral.com to learn more. ©2026 RingCentral, Inc. All rights reserved. RingCentral, RingCentral AI Receptionist, RingCentral AIR, and the RingCentral logo are trademarks of RingCentral, Inc. About UC AWARDS 2026 UC Awards is an annual workplace technology awards program recognising achievement in unified communications, AV, collaboration, AI, Microsoft Teams, meeting rooms, automation, security and related technologies, operated by Today Digital Ltd. Established in 2018, the program is judged by an independent panel of sector professionals. The 2026 results recognise 18 winners and 23 Highly Commended entries from 80 finalists across 18 categories. Winners were announced on 5 November 2026. UC Today covers unified communications, collaboration and workplace technology. Explore the full results at awards.uctoday.com/winners or contact press@uctoday.com for media inquiries. PR Contact Mariana Leventis mariana.leventis@ringcentral.com Source: RingCentral, Inc.

*RingCentral AI Receptionist (AIR) wins ICMI Best New Technology Solution*


*UC Today names RingCentral Best Integrated UC Solution*


BELMONT, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


[RingCentral, Inc](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.ringcentral.com%2F&esheet=54642608&newsitemid=20261117529089&lan=en-US&anchor=RingCentral%2C+Inc&index=1&md5=06ccffb9c76c19426ca73555e408b264) . (NYSE: RNG), a global leader in AI-powered customer engagement, today announced two industry awards recognizing its innovation in helping businesses serve customers, empower employees, and capture more opportunities.[RingCentral AI Receptionist](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.ringcentral.com%2Fai-receptionist.html&esheet=54642608&newsitemid=20261117529089&lan=en-US&anchor=RingCentral+AI+Receptionist&index=2&md5=0ac16d14ea7557687770f64bcbe5cfae) ™ (AIR) won Best New Technology Solution at the[2026 ICMI Contact Center Expo](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Ficmievents.com%2F&esheet=54642608&newsitemid=20261117529089&lan=en-US&anchor=2026+ICMI+Contact+Center+Expo&index=3&md5=7215f78a788675252fe9fa9886086563) , while[UC Today](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fawards.uctoday.com%2F&esheet=54642608&newsitemid=20261117529089&lan=en-US&anchor=UC+Today&index=4&md5=623eb61d6f030bee5372ef2ed1b980bd) named RingCentral Best Integrated UC Solution.


“Voice is the most natural way customers reach businesses, and they expect the conversation to keep moving, context intact, with a person there when they need one,” said Kira Makagon, President & COO, RingCentral. “Our platform brings AI and human agents together across the full conversation lifecycle, with humans in the loop. Businesses deliver better customer experiences, give employees time back, and capture more opportunities. These awards recognize that impact.”


“Strong customer engagement starts with integrated technology,” said Rob Scott, Publisher, UC Today. “RingCentral winning Best Integrated Solution at the UC Today Awards shows what happens when every capability works as one: seamless for teams, connected for customers. Congratulations to everyone at RingCentral.”


**Growing adoption. Measurable impact.**


The awards come as adoption of RingCentral’s AI portfolio accelerates. In the[third quarter of 2026](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.ringcentral.com%2Fwhyringcentral%2Fcompany%2Fpressreleases%2Fringcentral-announces-third-quarter-2026-financial-results.html&esheet=54642608&newsitemid=20261117529089&lan=en-US&anchor=third+quarter+of+2026&index=5&md5=e467e81d01aef0541a3eebe590119b15) , annual recurring revenue (ARR) from customers using at least one native paid AI product now represents approximately 15% of total ARR or over $400 million, doubling year over year. AI Receptionist, or AIR, now has more than 22,000 customers, up nearly 4x year over year.


AIR makes sure businesses never miss a call, turning every call into an opportunity by answering questions, capturing leads, booking appointments, and routing callers with context intact. It’s easy to deploy and works with existing phone systems.


The UC Today award recognizes the broader strength of RingCentral’s integrated approach: AI that automates interactions, assists employees, and analyzes conversations. Together, these capabilities form a connected flywheel across customer and employee communications, turning insights into action to make every conversation smarter.


**Helping customers handle more and achieve more**


At[Cartelligent](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.ringcentral.com%2Fwhyringcentral%2Fcasestudies%2Fcartelligent.html&esheet=54642608&newsitemid=20261117529089&lan=en-US&anchor=Cartelligent&index=6&md5=27ec927e6ece16a51dbd1148ad420fd2) , RingCentral’s AI suite helps employees spend less time on manual work and more time converting leads into customers.


“RingCentral’s AI suite has transformed our operations, allowing us to connect with 100% of live leads during business hours and move toward an 85% lead-to-signup target,” said Jessica Carstens, VP of Operations at Cartelligent. “With automated coaching and AI-generated summaries, we’ve replaced manual ‘busy work’ with strategic growth, all while maintaining an elite 9.85/10 customer satisfaction score.”


At[JTR Insurance Agency](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.ringcentral.com%2Fwhyringcentral%2Fcasestudies%2Fjtr-insurance.html&esheet=54642608&newsitemid=20261117529089&lan=en-US&anchor=JTR+Insurance+Agency&index=7&md5=d528ea6a0d8c0e4a630185f67e7dc5da) , RingCentral AIR cuts call routing from minutes to seconds, freeing employees to serve clients and saving on operational costs.


"Before AIR, it took an average of 5 minutes just to route a call. Now, it takes only 24 seconds,” said Todd Stanley, Owner of JTR Insurance Agency. “By letting AIR completely automate the handling of daily calls, our team no longer has to waste valuable hours manually answering and transferring them. That massive boost in efficiency gives us a 91% time savings and slashes our monthly operational costs."


To learn more about RingCentral and its Agentic Voice AI portfolio, visit[ringcentral.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fringcentral.com&esheet=54642608&newsitemid=20261117529089&lan=en-US&anchor=ringcentral.com&index=8&md5=f9425185a0436aab43174ce8cafd87e7) .
